character_data.text:
神秘生物艺术品，展出于20世纪30年代，参展时长约55年，诞生自9月19日秋。展出于大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国西南部。
尺寸：82 43/64×98 27/64×27 9/16in.
介质：灰羽枝
香调：木质调 没药 丝柏 麝香
灵感：飞兽的约定[兽] 珍兽使魔

character_data.title: 北风的脊背
character_data.text:
足够结实的皮革，能成为女巫翱翔天际的扶手；足够柔软的衬垫，不会压坏尘酿鹰引以为傲的羽毛。
一位强大的神秘学家为它施加了光学神秘术，使其能在受访者隐匿时随之隐形，不至于闹出“鞍在天上飞”的灵异事件。

character_data.title: “约定”
character_data.text:
名为阿德琳的女孩儿在幼时亲手缝制的装饰，作为她与受访者未来要定下契约、互相陪伴的约定的证明。
“戴着偶尔有点痒。”——受访者趁随行翻译夸夸其谈时，用爪子在地上书写了如此文字。

character_data.title: 女神的裙摆
character_data.text:
尘酿鹰随季节脱落的尾羽。在过去，女巫曾将它点缀在斗篷的下摆，据说此举能使人获得神明的祝福。
据受访者的随行翻译介绍，她本人收藏了满满一匣子尾羽，并且强调：这些尾羽是非卖品。

character_data.title: 年轮的缝隙
character_data.text:
他们说：神秘主义已死。
他们说：天才的时代即将到来。
一场旷日持久的辩论让17世纪的神秘学家们乱了阵脚。沼泽、黑森林与面包房里的保留地被粗暴地破开了门，大批自诩理性的新科学狂热者闯了进来。
一些人选择反抗，为了让黄金蟾蜍皮留在神秘学坩埚里。一些人选择共存，只为了给更多的秘学幼苗留下抽枝的时间。
但更多的存在，确是在那之后渐渐淡出了世界的视线，在时间巨树的年轮与年轮之间筑下了巢。
一些固执的人说：巨鸟、巫术、神秘学家都是有害的菌丝，在暗中腐蚀着巨木。
也有人说：飞禽、规律、有机生命本就是巨木的一部分，如今也只是与世界静默地共生着，仅此而已。

character_data.title: 最忙碌的人（鸟）
character_data.text:
这么麻烦的人，世界上居然出现了第二个！
不喜欢早起，不喜欢吃马铃薯蘸肉酱，一定要当着尘酿鹰的面吃煎蛋，喜欢看上周三的报纸……
那个小家伙和她的爸爸一模一样，堪称恶习的集合，简直糟糕透顶！
好在有一人一鸟能看住这两个麻烦精，缇威尔庄园的其他家人才不至于手足无措。
坦白说，我有时觉得格林杜尔比多沃卡阿姨更忙碌——格林杜尔，对，家里最大的那只鸟。
要知道，尘酿鹰是很高傲的生物。可他们父女俩竟然敢使唤格林杜尔——尘酿鹰最后族群的首领——去镇上给他们俩买过期的报纸！万幸的是，他们俩都没能和格林杜尔达成契约，不然我真不敢想，那样威风的格林杜尔该被他们折腾成什么样子了。
就写到这儿吧，听说多沃卡阿姨这几天要去伦敦的市集。她倒是能得到两天清闲时间，但可怜格林杜尔了。
                                                            ——格温·缇威尔

character_data.title: 无路可逃
character_data.text:
白雪松：……
小瑞安侬：……
白雪松：看来我们的受访者并未如约到场。
小瑞安侬：不……请等等，女士。
小瑞安侬：礼貌些，格林杜尔！不要装作自己不在！
格林杜尔：……咕。
小瑞安侬：呜……他在说，“您好，尊敬的女士。非常荣幸能够接受《UTTU》的采访……”
白雪松：从它的表情来看，这似乎并非它的原话。
小瑞安侬：好吧……
小瑞安侬：他在说：“我受够女巫、萨满、占星师的闹剧了，我要飞走了。”
白雪松：我理解你为什么要撒谎了，非常感谢你善意的谎言。
白雪松：但很可惜，在格林杜尔先生飞走前，我还有一些关于尘酿鹰的问题希望得到它的解答。
格林杜尔：咕！

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: <阿德琳的友人，原来你也拥有一片静谧而广阔的居所。#0|虽然对于尘酿鹰来说，没有妖精莓的地方无法成为栖息之地……>#4.5|【小瑞安侬】格林杜尔的意思是，他和小家伙们都很喜欢箱子里的环境！#11
character_voice.encontent: <Friend of Aderyn, I wasn't aware your residence was as serene and vast as my own.#0|But a land without Tylwyth Teg berries is not a place to call home for any Adar Llwch Gwin.>#5|Rhiannon: Glyndŵr just means to say that he and the little ones love the environment inside the Suitcase!#11

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: <又下雨了啊……>#0|【小瑞安侬】格林杜尔对雨天的情感比较复杂，一场小雨通常可以带来一次痛快的沐浴，#1.47|但持续的潮湿天气则会让他花费更多时间去梳理羽毛……#6.69|这时候就需要女巫使用干燥咒语来拯救她的伙伴们！#10.84
character_voice.encontent: <It's raining again.>#0|Rhiannon: Glyndŵr enjoys a refreshing shower in the rain every once in a while. #1.47|But he can get awfully wet, which takes hours to preen out. #5.81|Lucky for him he has a bird-training witch who knows her drying incantations!#10.29

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: <如果能在屋子外面那片神奇的土地上种出妖精莓，#0|或许可以让我的子侄辈，也就是小脑瓜他们在这片秘境发展新的族群。#4.5|至少，这里是战火难以烧及之圣所，对吗？>#10
character_voice.encontent: <Hmm ... If we could plant some Tylwyth Teg berries here in the Wilderness,#0|Bechan and the other fledglings could one day build their own clans here—#4.5|in a sanctuary free of conflict.>#10.5

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: *一阵逐渐沉重的呼吸声*#0|【小瑞安侬】格林杜尔？醒醒，我们还是回房间里睡吧？#2.04|虽然这里又安静又舒服，但要是你翻身的时候不小心把家具打坏了，那就不好了。#6.06
character_voice.encontent: *gradually louder snorting*#0|Rhiannon: Hmm? Wake up, Glyndŵr. Shouldn't we be sleeping in our room instead? #2.04|I know it's quite peaceful here, but I'd rather spare myself the stress of you rolling over and breaking something.#8.8

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: <你好，阿德琳的友人，你的脚步像小鹰一样轻悄，你接受过某种关于隐匿的训练吗？>#0
character_voice.encontent: <Greetings, friend of Aderyn. Your steps are as light as a fledgling's. Have you had training in the art of stealth?>#0

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: <你好，阿德琳的友人，你的脚步像小鹰一样轻悄，你接受过某种关于隐匿的训练吗？>#0
character_voice.encontent: <Greetings, friend of Aderyn. Your steps are as light as a fledgling's. Have you had training in the art of stealth?>#0

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: <在太阳升起前，尘酿鹰的双眼就能感知到光线到来的细微变化。#0|每天清晨喝些妖精莓酒，有助于保养我们的眼睛……#5|不过幼崽是不能喝太多酒的，你和阿德琳也一样。>#10
character_voice.encontent: <We Adar Llwch Gwins can discern the minuscule changes in light even before the sun rises above the horizon,#0|in part thanks to a daily thimble of Tylwyth Teg wine to keep our eyes sharp. #5.5|Such a thing is rationed for the fledglings, of course—that includes you and Aderyn.>#9.5

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: <清晨最适合晾晒羽毛。#0|将翅膀完全伸展开，静静感受温暖的日光浴，这样既可以驱赶昆虫、让羽毛变得蓬松，也不必担心被阳光灼伤……#2.5|或许你也应该摘下帽子，一起来晒晒头发？>#10
character_voice.encontent: <Morning is the time to dry one's feathers.#0|There's no better way to rid yourself of any irritating pests than to spread your wings beneath the morning sunlight.#2.5|Perhaps you ought to take off your hat and let your hair breathe every once in a while?>#10

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: <跳进一个箱子，却能在里面看到这样辽阔的星空，秘境真是神奇的存在……#0|这是哪位女神的馈赠，还是你们说的科学的产物？>#5.5
character_voice.encontent: <To think a vast sky full of stars twinkles inside this tiny box ...#0|Is this a gift from some generous goddess, or a product of what you call science?>#5

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: <现在应该到了幼崽睡觉的时间，保持规律且充足的睡眠才能长得更加强壮。#0|阿德琳小时候每次躲在被窝看故事书，我都会把她的小收藏拿走……>#7|【小瑞安侬】啊啊！格林杜尔的意思是，早睡早起对身体好！#14.5|要不我们都早点回房间睡觉吧？#18.35
character_voice.encontent: <It is high time the fledglings slept. Regular and sufficient rest is essential to proper growth.#0|Aderyn, in particular, used to stay up late reading storybooks, but I always made sure to confiscate—>#7|Rhiannon: Ahhhh! I mean—no, Glyndŵr means sleep is important for our health!#14.5|Let's all go back to our rooms, shall we? Heh heh ...#20.5

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: <佩戴缰绳当然违背尘酿鹰的天性，但我早已习惯了这些微小的不自在。#0|况且经过阿德琳家族的世代改造，这些骑具其实已经非常舒适。>#6
character_voice.encontent: <It goes against an Adar Llwch Gwin's nature to wear a saddle, but I've long grown accustomed to its presence.#0|Besides, the Tywyll clan spared no effort in ensuring the comfort of the riding gear.>#6.5

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: <好吧，我知道你在表示友好，但你过于轻柔的抚摸会让我感觉很痒。>#0
character_voice.encontent: <I understand you only mean to be friendly, but your petting is making me terribly itchy.>#0

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: <好吧，我知道你在表示友好，但你过于轻柔的抚摸会让我感觉很痒。>#0
character_voice.encontent: <I understand you only mean to be friendly, but your petting is making me terribly itchy.>#0

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: *柔和的鸣叫*#0|【小瑞安侬】尘酿鹰不会轻易驮载家族之外的人，不过格林杜尔说，如果你想出去兜兜风，#1.03|可以让我教你如何爬上他后背的鞍垫。#6.43
character_voice.encontent: *soft chirp*#0|Rhiannon: Adar Llwch Gwins generally only carry those they consider family, but Glyndŵr says if you'd like to ride him, #1.03|I should teach you how to climb onto his back properly.#8.7

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: <饮用妖精莓酒的时候，最好配上一条沙米尔虫，或者林德虫、奇罗谷蜥。#0|那肥美多汁的味道配上令鸟微醺的莓酒，每次都能让我多喝许多。>#5.5
character_voice.encontent: <Tylwyth Teg wine is best paired with Shamirs, Lindwurms, and Ziro Lizards.#0|I must admit, their juicy texture and rich flavor often have me drinking a little more than I planned.>#5

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: <此地的原野中，竟然有成群结队的魔精放养在建筑之间，#0|虽然并不都是尘酿鹰喜爱的种类，#4.5|但这样的活食对于鹰群实在益处良多。>#9|【小瑞安侬】什么？那些不是用来吃的，你千万不能去……#13|啊，没什么，格林杜尔的意思是，他觉得荒原上的生态非常好，哈哈……#17
character_voice.encontent: <I see that Critters have taken residence in a number of the buildings outside.#0|While they are not all species favored by Adar Llwch Gwins,#4.5| such an abundance of live prey will certainly be beneficial to the clan.>#9|Rhiannon: What?! No, you can't eat those! You mustn't—#13|ah, Vertin! Glyndŵr was just marveling at the wonderful ecosystem of the Wilderness, heh ...#16.19

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: <如果你想要为我梳理羽毛，请着重关注脑袋后面的这几根，#0|稍微用些力，将那些成熟的羽管捏开……>#4.7
character_voice.encontent: <Should you wish to groom my feathers, I'd ask that you pay special attention to those at the back of my head.#0| A little applied pressure does wonders in pulling the dry sheaths free.>#5

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: <如何管理族群是每一代尘酿鹰首领都需要向上一任首领学习的。#0|你的族人并无血脉联系，我很好奇，这样的族群是如何维系的？>#6|【小瑞安侬】格林杜尔说，箱子里的人虽然没有血缘，却亲如家人，他很佩服。#12.8
character_voice.encontent: <For the Adar Llwch Gwins, the art of leadership has been passed down from chieftain to chieftain for generations.#0|But you and those in your clan share no blood ties—what keeps them united?>#7|Rhiannon: I think what Glyndŵr is trying to say is, he's very impressed by how close you and your friends are.#12.8

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: <那位名为葛天的神秘学家看起来像是某种古老的妖精，#0|他能直接使用鸟类的语言沟通，真是令我感到意外的轻松。>#4|【小瑞安侬】格林杜尔很喜欢葛天先生。#10.63|对了，应该让格林杜尔也认识一下那位圆滚滚的松鼠先生，他真是位厉害的物种外交大使！#12.88
character_voice.encontent: <The arcanist Getian looks to be of an ancient breed.#0|It seems communication between birdfolk even from across the globe can be surprisingly smooth.>#4|Rhiannon: Glyndŵr seems quite fond of Mr. Getian. #10.63|Oh, maybe we should introduce him to that chubby squirrel, too! He's a real bridge builder, that one!#13.94

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: *爪子在地板上挠动书写的声音*#0|<阿德琳是挚友托付给我的孩子，我有义务看管她。#1.2|她冒失、粗心，但心肠不坏。如果她哪里犯了错，请不要太责怪她。>#3.7
character_voice.encontent: *writing on the floor with claw*#0|<Aderyn was entrusted to me by a dear friend, a duty which I take very seriously. #1.2|She may be all fingers and thumbs, but she has a kind heart. Please don't be too hard on her if she causes you any trouble. She means no harm.>#3.72

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: <当然，随时可以起飞。>#0
character_voice.encontent: <Of course, I'm always prepared to take flight.>#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: <无需寻找我，我会在隐蔽之处挑选时机。>#0
character_voice.encontent: <No need to search for me. I'll appear when the time is right.>#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: <狩猎的时候到了。>#0
character_voice.encontent: <Let the hunt begin.>#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: <请到我的身后来。>#0
character_voice.encontent: <Come, my wings will be your shield.>#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: <我将呼唤一位英勇的战士。>#0
character_voice.encontent: <Hear my call, brave warrior.>#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: <同族同心。>#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: <尝尝这个！>#0
character_voice.encontent: <Feel my might!>#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ

character_voice.encontent: <My eyes are locked on you.>#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ

character_voice.encontent: <Nature's blessing.>#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: <回到安宁的家园。>#0
character_voice.encontent: <Return to the serenity of home.>#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: <到我的身边来！>#0
character_voice.encontent: <Harken to my side!>#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ

character_voice.encontent: <It is a chieftain's duty to protect their clan. You've done an admirable job.>#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: <从你提供的照顾来看，你远比你看起来的样子更加体贴，#0|或许你愿意到阿德琳家一起照看幼崽吗？>#4|【小瑞安侬】格林杜尔邀请你去照顾族群的小鸟，#8|这是我们与尘酿鹰之间最亲近的象征！#10.33
character_voice.encontent: <You are far more considerate than you appear, friend of Aderyn.#0|Perhaps you'd care to return with me to babysit the fledglings?>#4|Rhiannon: Glyndŵr's invited you to our home to look after the clan's fledglings. #8|Only those who have truly bonded with an Adar Llwch Gwin are given that honor!#12.5

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: <作为箱子的主人，你是一位合格的首领。#0|我以族群的名义起誓，你将获得所有尘酿鹰的友谊与帮助。>#4
character_voice.encontent: <You are a worthy chieftain of the Suitcase.#0|In the name of my clan, I vow that you shall ever have the friendship of all Adar Llwch Gwins.>#4

skin.name: 格林杜尔
skin.skinDescription: 当一阵风愿意为人世停留。

1401031.speaker: 格林杜尔
1401031.content: 咕咕。<阿德琳的友人，很高兴看到你这样勤劳地巡视领地。>

1401031.speaker: 格林杜尔
1401031.content: 咿。<别担心，在你不在的时间，我会替你照看族群的安全。>

1401031.speaker: 小瑞安侬
1401031.content: 格林杜尔说，荒原的巡逻问题包在他身上，当然，再算上我一个！

1401031.speaker: 格林杜尔
1401031.content: 咕噜……<年长的帮助年幼的，是族群中天然的规则。>

1401031.speaker: 格林杜尔
1401031.content: 咕咕，咕。<何况你年纪虽小，却已经具备了合格的首领品质，这很难得。>

1401031.speaker: 格林杜尔
1401031.content: （鸟儿点了点头）<剩下的只需要交给时间，每只雏鸟都有变得强壮的一天，就像阿德琳一样。>

1401031.speaker: 小瑞安侬
1401031.content: 哎？怎么突然夸我，怪不好意思的……咳咳没什么，他说不客气，你已经很厉害了！

1401031.speaker: 格林杜尔
1401031.content: （鸟儿歪了歪头）<你是说，这是一处像安温那样的乐土？>

1401031.speaker: 格林杜尔
1401031.content: 啾啾。<除了那些衔接得很奇怪的山石和水流之外，我的确还没发现什么异常。>

1401031.speaker: 格林杜尔
1401031.content: 咕噜……咕。<真是一片神奇的土地，不过最好不要放松警惕，我会一直保持观察的。>

1401031.speaker: 小瑞安侬
1401031.content: 没事，格林杜尔就是喜欢操心，你就让他忙吧……哎哟，不要啄我的头发！

1401032.speaker: 格林杜尔
1401032.content: <阿德琳的友人，我有事想要托付。>

1401032.speaker: 格林杜尔
1401032.content: <如果日后我出了意外，希望你能帮助阿德琳和族群中幼小的尘酿鹰。>

1401032.speaker: 格林杜尔
1401032.content: <感谢你的慷慨，身为首领，我需要尽可能考虑族群的延续。>

1401032.speaker: 格林杜尔
1401032.content: <我相信同样庇护着族群的你，能够理解我的心情。>

1401032.speaker: 格林杜尔
1401032.content: （鸟儿愣了好一会儿，才继续挥动鸟爪。）

1401032.speaker: 格林杜尔
1401032.content: <阿德琳好像也说过类似的话。>

1401032.speaker: 格林杜尔
1401032.content: <孩子们总会有这种想要照顾他人的心情，但是……谢谢。>

1401031.content: 荒原中应该不会有什么危险

1401032.content: 在照顾它们之前，我会照顾好你
